item.title: Week 10: Vikings at Packers
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: GB -2.5 · O/U 42.5 | Model GB 77% vs. market 57% | On paper Green Bay has the edge (Green Bay's defense ranks 7th in YAC over expected per catch, -0.3 yds allowed), while Minnesota's best counter is to win up front (Minnesota's defense ranks 1st in QB hit + sack rate, 19% generated). Under center, Jordan Love ranks 3rd of 31 in EPA per dropback and Kirk Cousins ranks 12th; x-factor: Matthew Golden gets 29% of Green Bay's targets and 39% of its air yards, and Minnesota's pass defense ranks 3rd. The model favors Green Bay at 77%, mostly on passing matchup (4.6 pts) and starting QB (2.3 pts).
